newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING sees 1997 future provisions equal to 96.
newsitem.headline: ING sees 1997 future provisions equal to 96.

text.p: Financial services group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Thursday it expected its 1997 results to include provisions for future expenses roughly similar to the 1996 figure of 530 million guilders.
Earlier on Thursday ING reported that its 1996 net profits rose 25.4 percent to 3.32 billion guilders.

The increase came despite provisions of 530 million guilders before tax for future expenses, related partly to the cost of the introduction of a single European currency and computer and other changes connected with the new millennium.
Asked to specify whether there would be similar provisions in 1997, Jacobs said: "The provisions will be similar or just a little bit lower."
